## FAQs

1. Is there a completely free alternative to ElevenLabs? [...] If you have technical experience or a developer on your team, you do not have to pay ongoing character-based subscription fees to third-party cloud platforms. By downloading open-source speech models, you can run voice generation directly on your own computer or company servers, giving you 100% data privacy and unlimited text generation for free.

### Chatterbox

Chatterbox (developed by Resemble AI) is one of the most exciting breakthroughs in the open-source audio community. It was built specifically to challenge expensive proprietary platforms by providing an identical level of lifelike realism without the recurring price tag. Chatterbox is an MIT-licensed model that you can install with a single command line (pip install chatterbox-tts). [...] ### Fish Audio

Fish Audio is a rapidly growing platform that serves as a powerful alternative to ElevenLabs, especially if you handle large volumes of text or need to generate speech in multiple languages. Unlike traditional tools, Fish Audio uses a unique open-source design that is highly efficient. It can clone a voice perfectly with just a 15-second audio sample and is excellent at blending different languages naturally in a single sentence (like mixing English and Chinese flawlessly).

The Big Advantage: It is incredibly cost-effective. While ElevenLabs can become very expensive as your text volume grows, Fish Audio is optimized for bulk projects and long-form content like videos and narration.
